description: Use this when the user asks by when a company, free zone company or individual must register for UAE corporate tax, or about the late-registration penalty. The UAE corporate tax registration deadline under FTA Decision No. 3 of 2024 for a resident company, free zone company or natural person with a business, with days left, the late-registration penalty and its official source. A company incorporated on or after 1 March 2024 has three months from incorporation; one incorporated earlier has a fixed date set by the month its licence was issued; a natural person registers by 31 March after the first calendar year with business turnover over AED 1,000,000. Use only dates the user gave; if a needed date is missing, the result says which one. Do not use it for VAT registration (check_vat_registration).

incorporated_before_1_march_2024.description: Use when the exact incorporation date is not known.

incorporation_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, if different from the licence date.

legal_form.description: company (mainland), free_zone_company, or natural_person with a business.

turnover_over_1m_year.description: Natural person only: the first calendar year business turnover went over AED 1,000,000.
